q: What is this passage mainly about?

q: What is this passage mainly about?
explain: 整段围绕 'Global Issues' 展开

passage: One day, a tortoise and a hare had a race. The hare was sure he would win, so he took a rest. The slow but careful tortoise won the race.
q: Why did the hare lose?
explain: 兔子太骄傲停下休息，所以输了。

q: Why was Jiamin in a hurry?
options: He needed to return a book
He wanted to win a race

passage: A farmer picked up a dead hare and took it home. From then on, he stopped working and waited under the tree. But no hare came again, and his crops died.
q: What happened to the farmer in the end?
explain: 再没兔子来，庄稼死光，他没东西吃。

passage: Aki cried "Fire" to trick his friends. The boy told him the story of The Boy Who Cried Wolf and warned him not to tell lies.
q: What is the lesson of the story?

passage: Pandas live in China. They are black and white. They eat bamboo. Pandas are endangered animals.
q: What do pandas eat?

passage: Billy the little bird built a new warm house alone. Then all the other birds came to help him. Billy learned he had many friends.
q: Why did the birds come to help Billy?
options: Because they liked him and saw he was busy

passage: Many animals are in danger. People cut down forests and pollute rivers. Animals lose their homes. If we work together, we can still save them.

options: There are too many of them
People cut forests and pollute rivers

passage: Dangerous animals escaped from the zoo. A brown bear is catching fish in the park lake. A tiger is walking on a street. Police are trying to catch them.
q: Where is the brown bear?

passage: Dr Sun Yatsen was born in 1866 in Guangdong. He was a great leader. He loved the Chinese people and tried to free them. Today many roads and schools have his name.
q: Where was Dr Sun Yatsen born?

passage: Mozart was born in Salzburg, Austria, in 1756. He began to play the piano at four and wrote music at five. He was very poor and died at only 35.
q: How old was Mozart when he died?
explain: 35 岁去世。

passage: Deng Jiaxian was born in Anhui in 1924. He wanted to be a teacher, but his father asked him to study science. He finished his PhD in only two years in the US and was called the "Baby Doctor".
q: Why was Deng called the "Baby Doctor"?
options: He was the youngest in his class
explain: 他是班上最年轻的，所以叫“娃娃博士”。

passage: J.K. Rowling was born in 1965. Before writing Harry Potter, she was poor and had no job. She wrote in a coffee shop every day. Her book came out in 1997 and became a huge success.
q: Where did Rowling write the first Harry Potter book?
explain: 她在咖啡馆写书。

passage: If you see an old lady standing on the bus, you should give her your seat. It is polite. Don't push in line. Wait for your turn.
q: What is the polite thing to do on a bus?
options: Give your seat to an old lady
explain: 公交车上礼貌行为 = 给老人让座。

passage: In Japan, people bow from the waist. In Italy, people kiss. In India, it's rude to eat with the left hand. Different countries have different manners.
q: How do people in Japan greet each other?
explain: 日本人以鞠躬问候。

passage: A boy met a magic tree. He tried many words, but only "please" and "thank you" worked. The tree opened and showed him a room full of toys and chocolate.
q: Which words opened the tree?
explain: “请”和“谢谢”是魔法词。

passage: Ted is a polite bear. He wears clean clothes and says hello to friends. He often asks "Can I help you?" and carries heavy bags for others.
q: What makes Ted a polite bear?
options: He has good manners and helps others
explain: Ted 有礼貌 + 乐于助人。

passage: Daniel used to live in a big farm in the country. His family had sheep, cows and two dogs. But there was not much rain, so they moved to Sydney.
q: Why did Daniel's family move to Sydney?
options: Because there was not enough water
explain: 没有足够的雨水和水。

passage: Mr Brown went to Hawaii with his friends last month. They swam, sunbathed, went boating and watched dances. They will go there again and stay longer.
q: What did Mr Brown NOT do in Hawaii?

passage: Li Hua wrote to John. He will travel to Canada next month to visit John’s family. He wants to see lakes and waterfalls, and visit Chinatown in Toronto. His plane lands on June 12th at 1 p.m.
q: Where does Li Hua plan to visit in Canada?
options: Lakes, waterfalls and Chinatown in Toronto
explain: 湖泊、瀑布和多伦多唐人街都去。

passage: Janet sent a postcard from Milan, Italy. Milan is famous for fashion. She tried pasta, pizza and gelato. She will travel to France, Switzerland and Austria in the holiday.
q: What is Milan famous for?
explain: 米兰以时尚闻名。

passage: The lion caught a small mouse but let it go. Later the lion was trapped in a hunter’s net. The small mouse came and chewed the net, setting the lion free.
q: What is the moral of the story?
explain: 寓意：不要小看弱小的。

passage: Nelson Mandela was born in 1918 in South Africa. He studied law and tried to free black people. He was in prison for 27 years. In 1994 he became president of South Africa.
q: When did Mandela become president?
explain: 1994 年成为总统。

passage: We have 26 letters in the alphabet. Some letters are big, and some are small. We see them on signs, on a bus, and in books.

passage: English and Chinese are two languages. The words look different, but some things are the same. We say "hello" in English. We say "ni hao" in Chinese.
q: What is the same between English and Chinese?
explain: hello 和 ni hao 都表示友好的问候

passage: I have many friends at school. He is Tom. He is a happy boy. She is Lily. She is a kind girl. Miss Wang is our teacher.
q: Who is the teacher?
explain: 文中说 Miss Wang is our teacher

passage: I have a keyboard with many keys. This key is red. That key is blue. Here is a yellow key, and there is a green one.
q: How many colours are on the keyboard?
explain: 文中提到 red, blue, yellow, green 四种颜色

passage: A password is a special secret. It is made of numbers, like 2, 5, 8, 0. We type the password to keep things safe. Don't tell your password to others.

passage: I like to draw with my pen. First, I draw a circle. It is the sun. Then I draw two lines. They are the road. I paint the picture with red and green.

passage: A good listener is quiet and careful. We listen with our ears, not our mouths. When a friend talks, we hear every word. Be a good listener, and you have more friends.

explain: 文中说 A good listener is quiet and careful

passage: Exercise is good for us every day. In the morning, I run and jump. In summer, I like to swim. After school, my friends and I play ball. We do sports and stay healthy and happy!

explain: 文中说 We do sports and stay healthy and happy!

passage: This term we learned so much. We know letters, words, colours and numbers. We can draw, listen, exercise and play. Now we sing and dance in our music show.
q: What do they do in the music show?
explain: 文中说 We sing and dance in our music show

explain: 文中说 I get up at seven

passage: Today is a busy day. In the morning I went to school. We sang songs and played games. After school I helped Mum at home. At night I read a book in bed. I was tired but happy. What a great day!

explain: 文中说 After school I helped Mum at home

explain: 文中说 At four, school is over

passage: Today is my duty day. After class, I sweep the floor and wipe the desks. Ben helps me clean the windows. The little plants by the window look thirsty, so I water them. Now our classroom is clean and bright. Helping is fun!

explain: 文中说 Rules keep us safe and happy

passage: "Please", "thanks", and "sorry" are magic words. When we want something, we say "please". When others help us, we say "thanks". When we make a mistake, we say "sorry". A kind smile and a polite word can warm a cold day. Be polite and you will have many friends!
q: What are the three magic words?
explain: 文中说 Please, thanks, and sorry are magic words

q: What day is Road Helper Day?
explain: 文中说 Every Friday is our Road Helper Day

passage: I have a new home. It is small but very beautiful. There is a soft sofa in the living room. The kitchen is white and clean. My bedroom has a small bed and a desk. Welcome to my home — come in and have a look!

explain: 文中说 The kitchen is white and clean

explain: 文中说 I do my homework at the desk

passage: Every day I do many things. In the morning, I go to school and study with my friends. After school, I do my homework at the desk. Then I read a story or draw a picture. After dinner, I watch TV for a while with my family. A full day, a happy day!
q: What does the child do after dinner?
explain: 文中说 After dinner, I watch TV with my family

q: What can Tom do?
explain: 文中说 Tom plays the guitar

q: What do pandas eat?
explain: 文中说 They eat bamboo all day

explain: 文中说 We bring sandwiches

q: What do they eat at Spring Festival?
explain: 文中说 At Spring Festival, we eat dumplings

passage: A new year has come! I have many new wishes. I wish to study hard and read more storybooks. I wish to help Mum at home and share with my friends. Most of all, I wish a year full of smiles for my family and all my friends. Happy New Year to everyone!
q: What does the child wish to do at home?
explain: 文中说 I wish to help Mum at home

explain: 文中多次提到 spring

passage: I have many clothes in my closet. I wear T-shirts and shorts in summer. In spring, I like a light shirt and a skirt. In winter, I wear warm trousers and shoes. A hat keeps my head warm. Clothes make every season comfortable!

explain: 文中说 I wear T-shirts and shorts in summer

explain: 文中说 The blue skirt was eighty yuan — too expensive

passage: Numbers help us in many ways. We count money, count days, and count steps. At the store, we add prices to find the total. A book is thirty yuan, a pen is twenty — the total is fifty yuan. Numbers are everywhere!
q: What is thirty plus twenty?

passage: My grandma is a great cook. She makes tasty rice, soft noodles, and warm bread. Her vegetable soup is the best. I love sweet cakes after dinner. Good food keeps us strong and happy!
q: Who is a great cook?
explain: 文中说 My grandma is a great cook

passage: Today I am a small chef. First, I wash my hands. Then I break two eggs into a bowl. I wash the fruit and put it on a plate. I set the table with a knife, fork and spoon. Cooking with Mum is so much fun!
q: How many eggs does she use?
explain: 文中说 I break two eggs

passage: A healthy day starts with a good breakfast. We should drink water and eat fresh fruit. Sweets are tasty but not so healthy. Exercise makes us strong. Good sleep gives us energy. Small habits make a big difference!
q: What makes us strong?
explain: 文中说 Exercise makes us strong

passage: Last Sunday we had a wonderful picnic by the lake. The sun was warm and the water was blue. We put a big mat on the grass. We shared sandwiches, fruit and juice. After eating, we walked by the lake. It was a perfect day!
q: What did they do after eating?
explain: 文中说 After eating, we walked by the lake

passage: Spring is almost over. In my diary I wrote about every weekend. We flew kites in the park, learned to cook with Mum, and had a picnic by the lake. Spring brought us warm days and happy times. Thank you, lovely spring!
q: What did they do in the park?
explain: 文中说 We flew kites in the park

passage: A new term has started! I am in Grade 5 now. My new schedule is busy but exciting. I have new classmates and new teachers. I hope to study hard and make many friends this term. Let's have a great year together!
q: What grade is the child in?
explain: 文中说 I am in Grade 5 now

passage: We have many subjects at school. English is my favourite — it's easy and fun. Maths is a little difficult, but I try hard. Science teaches us about the world. PE keeps us strong. Art lets us create. Every subject is special in its own way!
q: Why does the child like English?
explain: 文中说 English is easy and fun

passage: Everyone has a talent. Tom can dance very well. Lily draws beautiful pictures. I can speak English and tell stories. On the school stage, we show our talents. Our teachers and parents are so proud. A talent is a gift — share it with the world!
q: What can Lily do?
explain: 文中说 Lily draws beautiful pictures

passage: Our school library is a quiet and wonderful place. There are many books on the shelves — storybooks, magazines, and science books. We use a library card to borrow books. We must return them on time. Every book opens a new world!
q: What do they use to borrow books?
explain: 文中说 We use a library card to borrow books

passage: It's Sports Day! The sun is bright and everyone is excited. Tom runs fast in the race. Lily jumps very high. Our team wins the relay race. We cheer and hug each other. Winning is great, but having fun together is even better!
q: What is more important than winning?
explain: 文中说 having fun together is even better

passage: Festivals around the world are amazing! In China, we celebrate Mid-Autumn with moon cakes and family dinners. Americans have Thanksgiving with turkey. Halloween means costumes and candy. Each festival has its own tradition. They all bring people together!
q: What do Americans eat at Thanksgiving?
explain: 文中说 Americans have Thanksgiving with turkey

passage: This year, our school has many new clubs. The robot club builds amazing machines. The chess club teaches smart moves. The photo club captures beautiful moments. The drama club puts on great shows. Follow your interest and join a club today!
q: What does the robot club do?
explain: 文中说 The robot club builds amazing machines

passage: Last weekend, our class volunteered at the city park. We picked up rubbish, planted flowers, and helped elderly people cross the road. Their warm smiles made us so happy. Helping hands and kind hearts make the world a better place!
q: What did they do at the park?
options: Picked up rubbish and planted flowers
explain: 文中说 We picked up rubbish, planted flowers

passage: Last Friday our school had a big Show Time. Each class prepared one act. We sang songs in English, danced to popular music, and told funny stories. The audience clapped and cheered. It was a show to remember forever!
q: What did the audience do?
explain: 文中说 The audience clapped and cheered

passage: Summer holiday is coming! My family is planning a trip. Dad wants to go to the mountains. Mum likes the beach. I think both are great ideas. We sit together and discuss our plan. A good trip starts with a good plan!
q: What does Dad want to do?
explain: 文中说 Dad wants to go to the mountains

passage: There are many ways to travel. A plane is the fastest but expensive. A train lets you see beautiful views. A bus is cheap but slow. In the city, the subway is quick. For short trips, I love riding my bike. How will you travel this summer?
q: What is the fastest way to travel?
explain: 文中说 A plane is the fastest

passage: Asking the way is an important skill. First, say "Excuse me". Then tell where you want to go. Listen carefully: go straight, turn left or right. A map can help you. If you get lost, don't worry — just ask a kind person for help!
q: What should you say first when asking the way?
explain: 文中说 First, say Excuse me

passage: China has many famous tourist spots. The Great Wall is known all over the world. Beijing has beautiful parks and great museums. Every city has its own special places. Travel opens our eyes to the beauty of our country!
q: What is known all over the world?
explain: 文中说 The Great Wall is known all over the world

passage: Buying souvenirs is part of every trip. In the gift shop, we saw many beautiful things — scarves, fans, and key rings. I tried on a silk scarf. Mum said the colour was perfect. We paid and got a receipt. A small gift carries big memories!
q: What did she try on?
explain: 文中说 I tried on a silk scarf

passage: Sending postcards is a sweet tradition. You write about your trip — the weather, the food, the fun. You put on a stamp and write the address. When your friend gets it, they feel your love from far away. I miss you — wish you were here!
q: What do you need to send a postcard?
explain: 文中说 put on a stamp and write the address

passage: The world has many different cultures. Some people speak English, others speak Chinese or other languages. Some eat with chopsticks, others with forks. Different foods, different ways — but all are amazing. We should respect and learn from each other!
q: Why is the world's culture amazing?
options: Because people are different but special
Because there is only one language
explain: 文中说 all are amazing, should respect each other

passage: Safe travels start with good habits. Always follow the rules on the road. Watch for danger signs and warnings. Stay with your group. Keep a phone with you. Be careful but not afraid. Remember — safety first, fun second!
q: What comes first when travelling?
explain: 文中说 safety first, fun second

passage: A journey ends, but memories stay forever. We visited amazing places, met kind people, and tried new foods. I wrote every day in my travel diary. Now I can share the stories with my friends. Every journey teaches us something new. Thank you, wonderful summer!
q: What did the child do every day?
explain: 文中说 I wrote every day in my travel diary

passage: Six years in primary school are almost over. We came as little children and will leave as confident students. There were challenges, but we grew stronger. The future is bright, and junior school is waiting. We are ready!
q: What comes after primary school?
explain: 文中说 junior school is waiting

passage: Everyone has a dream job. Tom wants to be a scientist to find new cures. Lily dreams of being a writer to tell amazing stories. I want to be an engineer to build great bridges. No dream is too big if you work hard. What's your dream?
q: What does Lily want to be?
explain: 文中说 Lily dreams of being a writer

passage: Real heroes are all around us. A firefighter runs into a burning building to save strangers. A teacher stays late to help a student. A police officer keeps our streets safe. Heroes don't wear capes — they wear brave hearts.
q: What does a firefighter do?
options: Runs into fire to save people
explain: 文中说 A firefighter runs into a burning building

passage: Sport is more than a game. Football and basketball teach us teamwork. Swimming and running build strong bodies. Every match is a chance to learn — winning is great, losing teaches us to try harder. A true champion never gives up!
q: What does sport teach us?
explain: 文中说 teach us teamwork, never gives up

passage: Doctors say, "You are what you eat." If we eat too much junk food, we get tired and weak. Fresh vegetables and fruit give us vitamins and energy. A balanced plate has rice, meat, vegetables and fruit. Eat smart, stay strong!
q: What happens if we eat too much junk food?
explain: 文中说 we get tired and weak

passage: Earth is our only home. Air and river pollution hurt people, animals and plants. Plastic stays in the Earth for hundreds of years. But we can help — recycle, plant trees, use less plastic. Small actions can save our beautiful planet!
q: How long does plastic stay in the Earth?
explain: 文中说 Plastic stays for hundreds of years

passage: Some inventions changed the world forever. Paper helped knowledge travel far. The light bulb turned night into day. The phone brought voices across oceans. The internet connected the whole world. What will the next great invention be?
q: What did the light bulb do?
explain: 文中说 The light bulb turned night into day

passage: What makes a true friend? First, trust — we tell our secrets to a friend we trust. Second, kindness — a friend helps without being asked. Third, forgiveness — friends make mistakes but forgive. True friends share joy and sadness. Friendship is a treasure forever!
q: What is the first thing in friendship?
explain: 文中说 First, trust

passage: Today we say goodbye to primary school. Six years gave us knowledge, courage and good friends. Believe in your dreams and set big goals. The future is bright for those who work hard. Thank you, teachers. Thank you, friends. The best is yet to come!
q: What did primary school give them?
explain: 文中说 Six years gave us knowledge, courage and good friends
